Game Overview

At its heart, Star Raiders is a arcade game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Star Raiders is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Star Raiders?

Star Raiders is a free arcade game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Star Raiders free to play?

Yes, Star Raiders is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
